integrity: Proved by an exact birth-death likelihood-ratio identity and radial stochastic ordering. Separate reproducible rational microstate checks; finite computations not substitutes for proof. Mathematical priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary laws only for the complete binary influence network under unbiased independent flips and q=2, with an N=4 q=3 reversal. No conclusion for transient laws, sparse graphs, or p=0. Direct publisher retrieval of the 2024 reference was rate-limited; relevant indexed sections were read.
title: Exact finite-population polarization order for pairwise q-voter influence and its three-voter reversal
